description:
The Huffy Ignyte 20" Bike is built for riders ready to step into independence. Its durable steel frame handles everyday adventures, from neighborhood rides to cruising with friends. Bold graphics and BMX-inspired style give the Ignyte a confident look that stands out on every ride.
Strong 20-inch wheels and grippy tires provide steady traction on sidewalks, driveways, and neighborhood paths. Front BMX-style pegs add extra attitude while the kickstand makes parking quick and easy between rides.
The Ignyte features two braking options to help riders build skills and confidence. A coaster brake allows simple pedal-back stopping, while the front hand brake introduces responsive pull-brake control. Comfortable grips and a padded saddle keep every ride steady and enjoyable.

components.description: Dual Brake System: Coaster brake for easy stopping plus a front hand brake for added control.
